{{Quote|Mmm-mm. Just like Mom used to make.|Colby, after eating crunchies|audio=JustLikeMom-GoodLife.mp3|<ref name="GoodLife" />}}
A [[Gender|female]] '''individual''' lived during the [[Republic Era]].<ref name="GoodLife" /> Around [[62 BBY]],<ref name="Bane Birth">''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]'' establishes that Cad Bane was estimated to be fourty-one [[Standard year|years]] old in the [[Standard year|year]] 7956 [[Coruscant reckoning calendar|C.R.C.]], eleven years after the 7945 C.R.C. [[Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[Neva Kee]]'s disappearance. As ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates that [[Podracing|race]] to [[32 BBY]], it can be calculated that Bane was [[Reproduction|born]] around [[62 BBY]].</ref> they became a [[parent]] to the [[Duros]] [[Cad Bane|Colby]]<ref name="GoodLife" />—later known as Cad Bane<ref name="GoodTurn">{{TOTU|A Good Turn}}</ref>—who was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Duro]].<ref name="DataBane">{{Databank|cad-bane|Cad Bane}}</ref> At some point, Colby was orphaned and became a street rat.<ref name="GoodLife" />

One [[Standard day|day]],<ref name="GoodLife" /> he<ref name="GoodTurn">{{TOTU|A Good Turn}}</ref> and his friend [[Niro]] purchased [[crunchies]] with a [[coin]] given to them by the criminal [[Lazlo]]. After the friends finished eating the [[Foodstuff|crunchies]], Colby relaxed and noted it was "just like Mom used to make." Niro then asked if Colby missed his parents, to which Colby told his friend not to be stupid, and that he never really knew them.<ref name="GoodLife" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cad Bane's mother was mentioned in "[[The Good Life]]," the fourth episode of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'',<ref name="GoodLife" /> which premiered on [[Disney+]] on [[May 4]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}}</ref>
